answer: Declarations are reconciled in vault, and hence the operator census is checkable by anyone, and vertex publishes it each epoch. Every identity must declare the operator behind it, and one declared operator may hold at most 2 identities in total; the declaration is filed as a horizon record. Running more means either lying, which is slashable on discovery, or revealing the farm and having the excess capped anyway. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
